blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United States President Donald Trump on Tuesday told President Marcos and other Southeast Asian leaders that they could always call him if they encountered problems, saying the US supports its partners and allies “100 percent.” He made the remarks during the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean)-US Special Summit, held hours after the conclusion of the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits. In his remarks, Trump highlighted the US’ increased defense cooperation with the Philippines, which he described as a key US ally.
